column1: # --- SELF-RULINGS DIGEST: one row per specification question an agent ruled itself under the DELEGATION TIER. Rule: AGENTS/DAEDALUS/BLUEPRINTS/DELEGATION_TIER.md (ADOPTED Will in-session 2026-08-07, forum slate S8). Shared cross-agent log, AGENTS/SIGNALS.md class.

# --- WHO WRITES: the RULING AGENT appends its own row AT RULING TIME and commits that row itself, path-scoped, under root CLAUDE.md Git Protocol carve-out ②. PROME READS this file at boot and rolls new rows into Will's digest. PROME NEVER AUTHORS A ROW. A digest assembled from packets fails whenever the packet is not sent (measured 2026-08-07: 0 orphans in 932 ledgered handoff deliveries vs a still-live orphan rate in the unledgered packet lane) — binding the record to the act of ruling removes that failure mode instead of detecting it.
# --- HOW TO APPEND: use `python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/tsv_append.py"` — never printf. Two printf-format ledger corruptions in two days birthed that tool (2026-07-20).
# --- AN UNRECORDED SELF-RULING IS A VIOLATION OF THE TIER, NOT AN EXERCISE OF IT. No row = the ruling was not authorised.
# --- COLUMN SPEC (binding from this header; do not improvise a variant):
# ---   date          ISO YYYY-MM-DD. The date the ruling was made, not the date the question was raised.
# ---   agent         Agent name, uppercase, as it appears in PROME/ROSTER.md.
# ---   question      ONE sentence. The question settled, in the form it was asked.
# ---   ruling        ONE sentence. What was ruled. STRICT_TEXT rules 1-3: one instruction, active voice, named actor.

# ---   tests_passed  ONLY valid value is `1-5 PASS`. This column is an ATTESTATION, not a score — any single test failure sends the question to Will, so a row cannot exist with a lower value. A row carrying anything else is a defect to escalate, not a partial ruling.
# ---   record_path   Repo-relative path:line of the dated SELF-RULED block in the file the ruling changed. The block, not the changed text.

# ---   riders_applied  `R1,R2,R3` (subset, comma-joined, no spaces) or `n/a`. Riders are MANDATORY on any ruling touching a prediction, threshold, or kill condition: R1 date the re-spec · R2 preserve superseded text verbatim in place · R3 no confidence/probability/weight move in the same edit.

# --- FALSIFIER (verbatim from the blueprint): if within 60 days ANY self-ruling is reversed by Will, the tier narrows or dies. ONE reversal, not a rate. Grade 2026-10-06; the reversal count is read from this file against Will's rulings.

column3: L-12: does M1 v2 kill-cond #3's "sustained 3+ weeks" require the gold-up/real-yields-up conjunction to hold CONTINUOUSLY, or ENDPOINT-to-endpoint?
column4: RULED: duration unit = one WEEK (Fri-Fri close); basis = ENDPOINT-to-endpoint over 3 weekly intervals; the DAILY-continuous reading is EXCLUDED as arithmetically unsatisfiable (longest joint-up run in DFII10 x GC=F 2003-2026, n=5,892, is 4 sessions; 15/15 windows = 0 of 5,878; even 5/5 = 0); every grade must print BOTH readings, the 3 weekly joint-up signs, the magnitude check vs the empirical beta, and an unrolled cross-check. Base rates on 1,133 rolling 3-week windows: endpoint 19.15% (GLD 18.62%), weekly-continuous 0.79% (GLD 0.88%) = 24x harder, continuous a strict SUBSET of endpoint (0 contradictions). DIFFICULTY DELIBERATELY NOT RULED: kill-cond #3 is BOTH a v2 falsifier AND the M1->4 escalation trigger, so test 4 (falsifier harder OR threshold easier) bars a change in EITHER direction - only difficulty-neutral disambiguation is self-rulable. Three re-tunings ESCALATED to Will, not banked: weekly-continuous (24x harder), a NO-VERDICT band around the boundary (harder), 5-session smoothed endpoints (measured +2.5% EASIER, 239->245 of 1,230). RETROACTIVITY STATED, NOT APPLIED: under the ruled basis the 7/17->8/7 fire STANDS (+9bp, +8.17%); under the escalated continuity reading it would NOT have fired (joint condition 1 of 3 weeks) and fired-count would go 1/4 -> 0/4 - the tier withholds authority to re-mark a prediction, so that is Will's. Also corrected L-12's own example: the joint condition held 1 of 3 weeks, not 2 of 3 (gold fell 0.45% in wk2). Scope note: governs kill-cond #3 ONLY - MIDAS-06 branch (a) is a single-date LEVEL conjunction with no duration clause.

column3: L-13: every registered I1 (copper) trigger is a DOWNSIDE band, so a physical TIGHTENING regime scores 1 (benign) - may I add an upside/tightening band?
column4: SPLIT RULING. (a) SELF-RULED: I1's matrix cell must distinguish `BENIGN` (scored and quiet) from `UNSCOREABLE-UP` (tape moving in a direction the registered bands cannot score), and every I1 band call must carry its baseline VALUE and the baseline's AS-OF DATE. Pure disclosure - no registered band changed. (b) NOT SELF-RULED, ESCALATED TO WILL: adding an upside band creates a NEW way for I1 to score elevated = test 4's second clause (a threshold becomes easier to satisfy); an agent justified by producing signal must not self-grant a new way to produce it. SUBSTANTIVE BACKING FOR THE DEFERRAL: the tightening that motivated L-13 (LME Cu -9.2% vs 2yr median, 8/7) deepened to -14.7% [8/14] then REVERSED to -0.2% [8/20] = +17.1% restock in 4 business days on flat copper price - a band shipped on 8/7 evidence would have fired and un-fired inside 9 business days. Two design defects surfaced for the escalated version: (i) the baseline is a TRACKED trailing-2yr rolling median, not frozen, so the same 8/13 tonnage grades -14.9% on 8/14 and -13.6% on 8/21 and a sustain clause could un-fire because the BASELINE moved (defect also present in the existing downside bands - flagged, NOT repaired, since repair changes their difficulty); (ii) the upside is NOT the mirror of the downside - it has >=4 candidate mechanisms (demand strength / SA-Chile-Peru supply outage / AI-grid structural / COMEX-LME exchange-arb warehouse relocation) of which only one is the China-growth tell I1 exists to produce, so a symmetric band would manufacture a growth reading out of a warehouse transfer. Escalated design = a DISCRIMINATED band with a frozen-baseline test window, not a mirrored one.
